name: Yorick
source:
At first glance, Yorick appears to serve Tai-Kuras unquestioningly, though it’s possible he does so under force or influence. He refers to himself in the third person and often speaks in a mixed dialect, blending different languages and tones in an odd, patchwork manner.

Little is known about Yorick’s past, except that he came under Tai-Kuras’s command after the defeat of the Phantom of Vanity. By the beginning of the game’s events, he resides with his master, Tai-Kuras, in a vast library where they lure unsuspecting victims.
